Players Committee card image of [[Daroe (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Information Broker. When deployed, may deploy a droid here or a Restraining Bolt from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During battle, may retarget an opponent's weapon targeting your droid to another one of your characters present (even Daroe).”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual2-Dark/large/daroe.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
